exposure: bilateral axillary sentinal lymph node dissection
cohort: Fourteen patients (9 female, 5 male) with surgically retained textiles (gossypibomas)
finding: Gossypibomas, while preventable, can have severe consequences and often present clinically after a significant delay.
mod_finding: Out of 14 cases of retained surgical textiles (textilomas), 3 occurred following cesarean sections.
